correctness.rationale: The exact six-type transition table defines 189 reachable hub/support states. Exhaustive deterministic transition composition gives the ten temporal classes with no period outside 1 or 3 and no first entry later than four. The ordered-petal lift is explicitly checked on every recurrent support signature, excluding collapsed hidden swap periods. Inclusion-exclusion on six petal types of weights (1,2,2,1,2,1) produces ten closed exponential-polynomial formulas for every integer r>=1. Standalone exact checker and 189-row table agree; separately implemented labelled-graph simulation verifies all 199287 states for r=1..5. Finite computation is exhaustive for the quotient but is not treated as the infinite-family proof without the state reduction and inclusion-exclusion.

value.rationale: A friendship graph is a natural one-point union of triangles, so multiple independent potential excitation circuits compete through a single common hub. The ten-class distribution resolves not merely eventual oscillation probability (which general theory already addresses) but the sharp finite-time kinetics of convergence and establishment of oscillations. In particular, despite eventual three-cycles becoming overwhelmingly likely, their times of first entry retain three asymptotically equal populations at times two, three and four. This precise nontrivial contrast is mathematically motivated and not a mere graph renaming.
